test_title: PYST 6: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, 'BELL' is coded as '111141' and 'HEAR' is coded as '172647'. How will 'MIKE' be coded in that language?
solution:
The position of the letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95e8d7f18fcf2b6801af6bc9d1c6a9b0f0dbfacea23a7bd8da0f6df6b5ef99f5.png] 

The logic that follows here is as shown below:

The code is the previous letter according to English alphabet of the given letters in reverse analogy

The word BELL is written as '111141'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b60b4f24756a05627ce6b5d6a4c6d015a3c1606e35ef5852ea550d98b2beef46.png] 

Similarly, the word HEAR is written as '172647'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a10dc50054ad5b5e28247f9f165e1fbcc0e56b79072417e591cc8f42137caa5.png] 

In the same way MIKE will be coded as 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5349c938311d47b76c4e361428fa6e9ddd61b86947b73f44a34c05acddd33ba1.png] 

**MIKE is coded as 410812**

Hence, the correct answer is **'410812'.**
